verdict.rationale: Twilio is a messaging platform, so automatic STOP/HELP keyword handling and opt-out suppression is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents keyword handling or suppressing opted-out contacts from future sends. The compliance items present (toll-free verification, 10DLC registration, spam monitoring) are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
